 Print Tamil Nadu CM Vijay mourns Krishnaraj. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay has paid tribute to veteran playback singer Krishnaraj, whose death at age 75 saddened the Tamil film industry. Remembering the singer’s contribution to cinema, Vijay said his distinctive voice and lively songs had won the affection of audiences. The Chief Minister shared his condolences on X on Thursday, October 22. He also offered support to Krishnaraj’s grieving family, friends, colleagues and music lovers. Vijay pays tribute to veteran singer Krishnaraj 
 In his Tweet, Vijay described Krishnaraj’s passing as a significant loss for Tamil cinema. He recalled how the singer’s voice and energetic performances had connected with listeners over the years. “I was shocked and deeply saddened to hear the news of the passing of Mr. Krishnaraj, the renowned playback singer of Tamil cinema. With his unique voice and songs brimming with enthusiasm, playback singer Mr. Krishnaraj had captivated the hearts of his fans. His demise is a great loss to Tamil cinema.I convey my deepest condolences and comfort to his grieving family, relatives, friends, film industry colleagues, and all music lovers. ” Popular songs that established Krishnaraj’s legacy 
 Among Krishnaraj’s best-known numbers are ‘Vellarikka Pinju Vellarikka’ from ‘Kadhal Kottai’, ‘Kaathadikkuthu Kaathadikkuthu’ and ‘Tirupathi Ezhumalai Venkatesa’ from ‘Ninaivirukkum Varai’. Another notable song was ‘Thanjavooru Mannu Eduthu’ from ‘Porkkaalam’. The song from ‘Porkkaalam’ earned Krishnaraj the Tamil Nadu State Government Award for Best Playback Singer. His work helped make his voice recognisable to audiences who followed Tamil film soundtracks. Krishnaraj shared a close professional connection with music composer Deva and lent his voice to several of the composer’s popular film songs. Their collaboration became an important part of his career. The singer also worked with prominent composers, including Ilaiyaraaja, A. R. Rahman and Yuvan Shankar Raja. According to News18, Krishnaraj passed away following health-related issues. Singer’s death follows Deva’s passing 
 Krishnaraj’s death came only days after the passing of veteran Deva. Krishnaraj’s last known film song was reportedly recorded for ‘Soorarai Pottru’, the 2020 film starring Suriya. G. V. Prakash Kumar composed the music for the film.
